title: Frameless releases “Drain” a deep emotional song of longing and liberation
htmlContent:
Frameless's new single, "Drain," is a captivating blend of emotional honesty and powerful sound. The song feels like a mix of whispering secrets and intense feelings, creating a unique listening experience.

"Drain" takes listeners on a journey through deep emotions. It explores a struggle between feeling hopeless and searching for hope, between what is real and what isn't. You can sense the heaviness of doubt in the lyrics, but there's also a sense of change, like leaving the past behind and moving towards something brighter and lighter.

https://open.spotify.com/album/4Jf92SdGkn0djMWHm47IJq

Frameless fully immerse themselves in this song, expressing feelings of vulnerability and longing with a passion that resonates on both personal and universal levels. The production of the track reflects this emotional journey, starting softly and building up to an almost cinematic finale.

"Drain" is a heartfelt expression that says to let go and take a path to new beginnings. It exists in the delicate space between what we have experienced and what we hope for, encouraging us to find beauty in breaking down, letting go, and starting fresh.
